## Summary

Describe what this change does and why.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Refactor
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Build or CI

## How it was checked

- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] Tried it in the running app on Windows or Linux (say which)

## Notes for the reviewer

Anything that needs extra attention, such as audio engine timing, IPC changes or new settings.
